semantics.checkpoint: learning state v2 validates history before weight application; serial v1 restores fresh history; native checkpoint v2 binds shared guard controls
semantics.history: patience, counters, bounded recent rewards, finite scalar latest metrics, last-step identity and retained failure; process-local clocks restart
semantics.observation: coordinate local post-step timing/cost and monitor failures, then agree on guard controls
semantics.failures: post-update diagnostics poison every peer until a complete healthy checkpoint reload; failed snapshots retain failure
semantics.recovery: preserve existing monitor callback references; clear stale target failure and transient rollout timing; exact subsequent learner update matches combined reference
semantics.admission: preflight v4 checks guard controls before forward; differing patience, streak or observation count rejects without learner mutation
semantics.noop: globally empty batches do not create, advance or reset guard history; pending batches retain prior step-identity deduplication
